verdict.rationale: vLLM's GitHub README documents installation with uv (recommended) or pip, and the homepage gives a one-line command, `uv pip install vllm --torch-backend auto`. An official Docker image is also available on Docker Hub, so the runtime installs through standard package managers. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that installation is quick or smooth, and no detail on platform-specific install caveats such as GPU or CUDA backend requirements.
